lines.en: Good morning. How can I help you?
Hi, I'd like to renew these two books, please.
Let me check. The first one is due today, so you can keep it for another two weeks.
Great. What about the second one?
I'm afraid it's already overdue by three days. You'll need to pay a fine of six yuan.
Oh, I didn't notice. Can I pay by phone?
Sorry, the machine only takes campus cards. There's one next to the entrance.
All right. And can I reserve a study room for tomorrow afternoon?
Of course. Rooms are free from two to five. Just bring your card.
Thanks a lot. I'll do the payment first.

qs.q: How long can the student keep the first book?
qs.why: you can keep it for another two weeks

qs.q: Why does the student need to pay six yuan?
opts: Because the second book is overdue
qs.why: it's already overdue by three days ... a fine of six yuan

qs.q: How can the student pay the fine?
qs.why: the machine only takes campus cards

lines.en: Come in. You're applying for the weekend job at the cafe, right?
Yes. I can work Saturdays and Sundays, but I have classes on Friday afternoons.
That's fine. We need someone from ten to six. Have you worked in a cafe before?
Not in a cafe, but I helped in my uncle's restaurant last summer, so I know how to take orders.
Good. The pay is twenty yuan an hour, and we provide one free meal per shift.
That sounds reasonable. When would I start?
Next Saturday, if your documents are ready. Bring your student card and ID.
I will. Thank you for the opportunity.

qs.q: When can the student NOT work?
qs.why: I have classes on Friday afternoons

qs.q: What experience does the student have?
qs.why: I helped in my uncle's restaurant last summer

qs.q: What will the student bring next Saturday?
qs.why: Bring your student card and ID

lines.en: Ticket office. What can I do for you?
I booked a train to Guilin for Friday, but my exam has been moved. Can I change it to Saturday?
Let me see. There are seats left on the eight o'clock and the two o'clock trains.
The morning one, please. How much extra is it?
Changing is free once, but the price difference is twelve yuan.
That's fine. Do I need a new paper ticket?
No, your passport works. Just show it at the gate.
Perfect. Thanks for your help.

qs.q: Why does the student change the ticket?
Which train does the student choose?
What does the student need to show at the gate?
qs.why: your passport works. Just show it at the gate

lines.en: What seems to be the problem?
I've had a headache for three days, and I can't fall asleep at night.
How many hours do you sleep?
About four. I have exams next week, so I drink coffee to stay awake.
That's probably the cause. Too much coffee and too little sleep make the headache worse.
Should I take any medicine?
Not yet. Stop coffee after noon, go to bed before eleven, and come back if it continues.
All right. Thank you, doctor.

qs.q: How long has the student had a headache?
qs.why: I've had a headache for three days

qs.q: What does the doctor think is the cause?
opts: Too much coffee and too little sleep
qs.why: Too much coffee and too little sleep

opts: Stop coffee after noon and sleep earlier
qs.why: Stop coffee after noon, go to bed before eleven

lines.en: Professor, may I have a word about the essay?
Of course. It's due on Thursday, isn't it?
Yes, but I've been ill since Monday. Could I hand it in next Monday instead?
Do you have a medical note?
I have the doctor's receipt. I can bring the note tomorrow.
That's acceptable. But the topic you chose is quite broad. Narrow it down to one city.
I'll focus on Guilin then. Should I keep the same structure?
Yes, but add one paragraph about the local economy.
Understood. Thank you for being flexible.

qs.q: When was the essay originally due?
Why does the student ask for more time?
What does the professor ask the student to do?
opts: Narrow the topic to one city
qs.why: Narrow it down to one city
